title: CYVHUB Update
description: Latest CYVHUB script and key-system release notes.

entries.title: Build a Gun Army
changes: [+] Auto Collect Coins added. Fires CurrencyPickup for all LootSpawnedClient GUIDs as soon as they hit the path, without teleporting or walking.
[+] Collect Mode added with All (Instant Path) and Near Player modes.
[+] Collect Interval added with a 0.05–1 second scan-rate slider.
[+] Collect All Now added for current coins on the path.
[+] Auto Roll Crates added with automatic open, buy, and discard flow.
[+] Auto Open Crates added when RolledWeapon is nil.
[+] Auto Buy added when currency is at least the crate cost.
[+] Auto Discard added with Auto-Decline when the Broke filter is enabled.
[+] Roll Delay added with a 0.2–3 second slider.
[+] Auto Place New Guns / Mutations added for exact unit slots and in-place mutation upgrades.

entries.title: CYVHUB Key System
changes: [+] Build a Gun Army added as a new supported game (PlaceId 134162299584012).
[-] Remote Game Status removed. Games now use the local SUPPORTED_GAMES table instead of fetching or caching gamestatus.json.
[~] Scripts Cards polished with tighter rows, smaller icons, softer strokes, compact Run/Info buttons, and a wider name block.
